card.name: The word see before section cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "see" right after an open bracket, introducing a cross-reference to a labeled section such as Overdosage or Clinical Studies. It also fires on "the" after a clause about acute ingestion.

modes.label: Bracketed see
modes.description: "see" opening a bracketed pointer to a numbered label section.
modes.example: periodically reassessed to determine the need for maintenance treatment [<<see>> Clinical Studies (14.2)

modes.label: The after ingestion clause
modes.description: "the" starting the subject after an introductory clause about treating acute ingestion.
modes.example: As a guide to treatment of acute ingestion,<< the>> acetaminophen level can be plotted

card.writes: It suppresses tokens starting with capital E, so it steers away from those continuations.
card.plain: It marks the point where a label sentence ends and points the reader to another section, as in "[see Warnings and Precautions (5)]".
